dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts foreign cylinder manufacturers, parties requesting reevaluations, and federal transportation regulators.
dimensions.evidence: an entity that manufactures cylinders outside of the United States that are intended to be represented, marked, certified, or sold as qualified

dimensions.assessment: Creates stricter approval conditions, potential one-year approval limits, mandatory annual inspections for good cause, and cost recovery for inspections.
dimensions.evidence: an approval provided to an FMOC... shall be for a period of not longer than 1 year

dimensions.assessment: Allows for the recovery of all associated costs of foreign inspections, but does not specify total federal spending or macroeconomic impact.
dimensions.evidence: allow for the recovery of all associated costs of foreign inspections to include travel, time, and other costs

dimensions.assessment: Requires new regulations, public comment processes, application disclosures, and revised inspection authority for the Department of Transportation.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall promulgate regulations to provide that an approval provided to an FMOC... shall be for a period of not longer than 1 year

dimensions.assessment: Institutes permanent statutory changes to regulatory oversight and annual listing requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, and annually thereafter, the Secretary shall publish

missing_information: Total number of foreign manufacturers affected
Exact dollar figures for inspection fee recovery
importance_detail.rationale: The bill increases regulatory oversight, inspection frequency, and application requirements for foreign manufacturers of gas cylinders used for hazardous materials transport.
